_comment: Per-desk + persona model routing (research.25; grok firebrand 2026-08-07). Desk default: DeepSeek (S332 — pennies, canon-ok). Firebrand is a separate seat: needs more heat/voice than deepseek-chat's tidy default without leaving the penny band. Live OpenRouter prices (2026-08-07): deepseek/deepseek-chat ~$0.26/$1.03 per 1M; llama-3.3-70b ~$0.10/$0.32; hermes-4-70b ~$0.13/$0.40; x-ai/grok-4.x ~$1–2/$2–6 (too rich for M–F cron). Override per-run with --provider/--model.
